note: 350-card base set split into tiers: Common #1-100, Uncommon #101-200, Rare #201-300, Super Rare #301-350 (many stars and rookies repeat across tiers; Super Rare adds legends like Mays, Aaron, Jeter, Ichiro). Rookies carry RC flags. Autograph groups include Finest Autographs (FA), Finest Ink (FI), Mega (FMA), Moments, Personality (FPA), Gustographs (GA), Rookie Cup Anniversary/Dual (RCA/DRCA) and Rookie Patch Autographs (RPA); Finest Mystery Redemption is still TBA. Parallels omitted.
